note: Haven: a smart-home dashboard. Rooms in a tree by floor, scenes, lights (switch, dim, colour), climate, blinds, device tiles whose calls take a while (progress, then a toast), a floor plan on a canvas with media, automations as a node graph with schedules on a timeline, an energy page by day and by device, security modes and notifications, device state from a simulated service, and a settings page from the settings schema; light and dark themes, English, Italian and Arabic. Cmd+1 to Cmd+4 and Cmd+, change the page, Cmd+Shift+P runs a command, Cmd+T switches light and dark, Cmd+L the language, Cmd+Shift+A the security mode, Cmd+Shift+N the notifications, Up and Down the target temperature, Alt and Up or Down the room.

climate.awayTarget.title: Away temperature
climate.awayTarget.description: The target the Away scene sets in every room, in degrees.

scenes.blindsMs.title: Blinds speed
scenes.blindsMs.description: How long the blinds take to move in a scene, in milliseconds.

energy.dailyBudget.title: Daily budget
energy.dailyBudget.description: The energy a day should stay under, in kWh, shown on the Energy page.

devices.notify.title: Device notifications
devices.notify.description: Show a note in the corner when a device has answered.

ui.language.title: Language
ui.language.description: English, Italian or Arabic (right to left).

computed.palette: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled), { title: it.title, detail: it.keyLabel ?? it.category, run: it.name })}}

pickRoom.note: with: id, a row of the rooms tree (r0 to r3; the floors only open and close)

deviceCall.note: with: i. A device call takes a while: the tile shows its progress, then the new state and a toast. A host would make it a call with onAsyncCall; here a timer stands in for the device.

showToast.note: with: message. A note in the corner for a few seconds, kept in the notifications too

stepRoom.note: with: by, -1 or 1: the previous or next room, wrapping

children.note: The whole window, in the locale's direction: right to left, the sidebar is at the right

children.text: {{t('summary.lights', { on: computed.lightsOn, total: length(computed.room.lights) })}}{{state.scene ? t('summary.scene', { scene: t('scene.' + computed.sceneKey) }) : ''}}

children.note: The icon switches the light: a toggle drawn by the icon under it
children.label: {{light.name}}
